title: Feature request: Make the cursor blink
body:
The cursor in Claude Code doesn't blink and it's driving me nuts. Every other editor I use (cursor/windsurf) has this basic feature.

When I'm jumping between my browser, and Claude Code, I waste precious seconds hunting for that damn static cursor. It's a small thing but seriously impacts workflow - especially when I'm context-switching between docs and implementation.

Could we get a simple toggle for cursor blinking? Nothing fancy needed - just the standard blink behaviour that's been in text editors since the 80s.

Not a dealbreaker but would make Claude Code feel way more natural alongside my other tools. Any chance this could make it into the next sprint?​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
author: sagarspatil

top_comments.author: christian-schlichtherle
top_comments.body: I just started to use claude-code and this is already annoying big time: I work with IntelliJ IDEA and claude code is running in one of many editor panels. Without the blinking cursor I do not know if claude code has the focus or not, resulting in text input going into the wrong editor panel many times.

top_comments.author: abraithwaite
top_comments.body: I'm constantly searching for my active window and this is driving me nuts too.
